description: Get a signed URL for downloading a completed log export. The export must already be finished; use get_log_export to confirm readiness and start_log_export if it has not run yet. Enterprise-gated. Returns 403 on non-Enterprise Portkey plans.

export_id.description: The unique ID of the log export to download

name: download_log_export

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
